summary: Iteration 9 — verified the App.js Protected-route fix for the ChangePasswordGate flow and re-ran regression. FIX VERIFIED: created a throwaway QC user (admin POST /users with name+initials+role, then admin PATCH password=Temp@Pass1 to set a known temp), logged in via the browser at the preview URL, confirmed (a) 'Set a new password' dialog appears with all four required data-testids (change-password-form, current-password-input, new-password-input, submit-change-password-btn); (b) NO CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay — page.on('pageerror') captured 0 errors, and DOM probe returned hasRuntimeError:false with iframeCount:0; (c) no dashboard/page CONTENT rendered behind the modal — Protected now returns only <Layout><ChangePasswordGate/></Layout> when must_change_password is true, so only Layout shell/nav is visible (probe found nav labels 'Instruments'/'Audit Trail' but no dashboard body); (d) completing the change redirected to /login, showed the 'Password updated' toast, and logging back in with the new password landed the user on / with full nav+content. The only 4xx during the gate window were 2 expected 401s from AuthContext calling /api/auth/me (an exempt path, returns 401 pre-login) — these surface as browser 'Failed to load resource' network log lines only, NOT as unhandled runtime errors or a CRA overlay. Regression: admin@lims.local / qa@lims.local / qc@lims.local all log in with no gate, land on /, and Layout renders. Login page contains none of the six credential strings. Logout revokes the bearer token (GET /auth/me: 200 -> POST /auth/logout: 200 -> GET /auth/me: 401). Backend pytest: 155/156 pass (see 'minor' below).

minor.issue: test_auth_security.py::TestPasswordsNeverExposed::test_login_response_has_no_password fails because the login body now includes a 'password_changed_at' ISO timestamp (metadata only, no secret). The test's substring check flags the literal word 'password' inside that field name. No actual password / hash is leaked (grep for $2b$ / password_hash on the body returns empty). Either tighten the test to look for hash-shaped values, or rename the field to 'credentials_updated_at' if it truly must not contain the word 'password'.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. The component sets aria-describedby='change-pw-desc' manually, but Radix expects a <DialogDescription> child. Cosmetic a11y polish; not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten test_login_response_has_no_password so 'password_changed_at' is not falsely flagged (or rename the field).
(Optional) Replace the manual aria-describedby paragraph in ChangePasswordGate with Radix <DialogDescription> to silence the console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Protected() in App.js now duplicates <ChangePasswordGate/> in both branches. Since the early-return branch already returns the gate, the second instance on the authenticated branch (line 40) will only render null (guard clause returns null when !user.must_change_password), so it is a no-op. Could be removed for clarity.

AuthContext presumably calls /api/auth/me on every mount and gets 401 pre-login — logs a browser 'Failed to load resource' each time. Consider skipping the call when no token is present or when the previous /auth/me already returned 401, to keep the console clean.

Previously flagged and still open: server.py (843 lines) and batches.py (1269 lines) exceed the 700-line file-size guideline; PASSWORD_EXEMPT_PATHS uses startswith prefix matching (safer as a set of exact paths).

success_rate.backend: 99.4% (155/156 pytest — the 1 failure is a test assertion issue, not a functional regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the four required verification points (gate appears with 4 testids; no CRA overlay / no unhandled runtime errors; no dashboard content behind modal; change→sign-out→new-pw login works) and all three shared-account logins land on / without the gate

seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway TEST_qc_<random>@lims.local user, PATCHed a known temp password, walked the gate flow, then deactivated the user via admin PATCH {active:false} at cleanup. No changes to shared accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UserIn requires: email, name (NOT full_name), initials, role, optional password. Cloudflare in front of the preview URL returns error 1010 to urllib without a User-Agent header — set UA='Mozilla/5.0 ...' on all raw HTTP requests. The AuthContext /api/auth/me 401 pre-login is expected browser console noise, not a bug. Backend test_login_response_has_no_password is the only failing pytest and is a false positive on 'password_changed_at' metadata.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Protected wrapped page children (Dashboard, etc.) inside Layout AND rendered ChangePasswordGate alongside them, so a temp-password user's page components mounted, their useEffect fired background GETs, backend rejected with 403 'temporary password', and the axios rejection surfaced as CRA's 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix in App.js: when user.must_change_password is true, Protected early-returns <Layout><ChangePasswordGate/></Layout> WITHOUT the page children, so no background fetches fire. Verified: pageerror listener captured 0 errors, DOM has no CRA overlay iframe, and the only 4xx traffic while the gate is visible is the exempt /auth/me endpoint from AuthContext.
